assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Site boundary and three key areas use provisional polygons from brief/site-package/geometry/provisional_boundaries.geojson (PROV-SITE-001, PROV-KEY-001/002/003). They are not official redlines and cannot be used for precise area calculation or approval.
assumptions.impact: All area metrics (site_area_sqm, key_area_area_sqm, ratios) are provisional and must be recalculated when official polygons are supplied. Organizer data gaps do not block content scoring.

assumptions.statement: All spatial proposals (land use partition, building footprints, road corridors, phasing, landmarks, scenario nodes) are conceptual suggestions for professional teams to deepen, not statutory planning conclusions.
assumptions.impact: No parcel-level demolition/renovation, engineering feasibility, investment commitment, or approval conclusions are claimed.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints are concept-stage massing placeholders generated inside design parcels; official building stock, floor areas, and heights are data gaps.
assumptions.impact: building_footprint_area_sqm and building_count are indicative of design intent only.

assumptions.statement: Road centerlines are concept corridors connecting cores/wings, not official road redlines; alignment and cross-section require official transport planning data.
assumptions.impact: road_network_length_m is indicative; no road redline claims are made.

assumptions.statement: AI scenario cards, test/validation scenarios, events, and operation mechanisms are concept suggestions; none are approved operations, government commitments, or confirmed investment.
assumptions.impact: scenario_node_count reflects proposal-level scenario cards; operational feasibility requires separate review.

assumptions.statement: Land-use partition is a topology-complete design partition of the provisional site boundary (no gaps/overlaps) using MNR land-use codes; it is not an approved regulatory land-use plan.
assumptions.impact: Land-use ratios are design-proposal values awaiting official regulatory plan confirmation.
